project_info.theme: Quán Nhậu Tự Do branch promo at 86 Hồng Tiến
project_info.color_palette: White, red, black, deep green, warm amber night lights, food natural tones

main_subject.detail: Vertical restaurant promo poster pairing a real nighttime venue photo of the 86 Hồng Tiến branch with a foreground cutout collage of beer and signature dishes around a central hotpot burner.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic venue-and-food composite, nightlife restaurant promotion, crisp sticker-cutout food collage

composition_elements.text: CHẠM CỐC TỰ DO – MỞ VỊ MỚI TẠI 86 HỒNG TIẾN
items: Top Left: Red and black headline on white background 'CHẠM CỐC TỰ DO – MỞ VỊ MỚI TẠI 86 HỒNG TIẾN'.
Top Right: Rounded-corner nighttime photo of the 86 Hồng Tiến branch with glowing signs and crowded outdoor seating.
Bottom Left: Two cutout beer glasses and plated dishes with white sticker-style outlines.
Bottom Right: Additional cutout dishes including sliced meat with vegetables around the green tabletop.
Center/Background: Large central hotpot on a tabletop burner layered over the branch photo, with the whole lower half composed as a food-collage spread.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: Mixed night venue and food lighting
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm amber venue illumination, crisp collage edges, inviting nightlife ambiance, bright dish highlights
